title: [BUG] Invalid parameter: messages with role 'tool' must be a response to a preceding message with 'tool_calls'.
author: coolbeevip

comments.author: coolbeevip
comments.body:
If `await tool.async_call(**args)` raises an exception (e.g., `DuckDuckGo RatelimitException`)

https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/blob/1999dc0a27cda0eff22462cea37ac3166745dc53/camel/agents/chat_agent.py#L3480

the `tool_call` message  is never recorded in the message buffer.

https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/blob/1999dc0a27cda0eff22462cea37ac3166745dc53/camel/agents/chat_agent.py#L4223

However, the exception handling  proceeds to create and append a `tool` message. 

https://github.com/camel-ai/camel/blob/1999dc0a27cda0eff22462cea37ac3166745dc53/camel/agents/chat_agent.py#L4279

This results in an unpaired `tool` message.

OpenAI API requires `tool_call` and `tool` messages to always appear in pairs. This mismatch causes an API error.

comments.author: fengju0213
